<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">
<style id="tll-acct-gate-v2">
/* 9 Oct 2026: same cure as /account. The signed-out card sits in a data-ms-content="anonymous" block that shows until Memberstack hides it, so it flashes on login and stays when Memberstack is slow, hiding the editor. Hidden by default; the script shows it only once Memberstack says there is no member, or after six seconds with no answer. */
html:not(.tll-anon) [data-ms-content="anonymous"]{display:none !important}
</style>
<script id="tll-acct-gate-v2-js">
(function(){
  var done=false; function anon(){ if(done) return; done=true; document.documentElement.classList.add('tll-anon'); }
  function check(){ var ms=window.$memberstackDom; if(!ms||!ms.getCurrentMember) return false;
    ms.getCurrentMember().then(function(r){ if(!r||!r.data) anon(); else done=true; }).catch(function(){ anon(); }); return true; }
  var n=0, iv=setInterval(function(){ if(check()||++n>20){ clearInterval(iv); if(n>20) anon(); } },300);
  setTimeout(anon,6000);
})();
</script>
<style id="tll-edit-v2">
/* Edit profile v2 (2026-09-29, screen 12). Ledger card and designation cards sit around the Memberstack profile form, which is untouched. */
[data-tll-edit="ledger"]{background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8;border-radius:12px;padding:22px 24px;margin:0 0 26px}
[data-tll-edit="ledger-eb"],[data-tll-edit="desig-eb"]{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace !important;font-size:11px !important;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600 !important;line-height:1.4 !important;margin:0 0 10px}
[data-tll-edit="ledger-eb"]{color:#00C9C8}
[data-tll-edit="ledger-n"]{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif !important;font-weight:800 !important;font-size:30px !important;line-height:1.1 !important;color:#F7F1E8;margin:0 0 8px}
[data-tll-edit="ledger-sub"]{color:#cfcbc4;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 14px}
[data-tll-edit="ledger-link"]{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:#00C9C8;text-decoration:none}
[data-tll-edit="desig"]{margin:26px 0 30px}
[data-tll-edit="desig-eb"]{color:#067A79}
[data-tll-edit="desig-grid"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
[data-tll-edit="desig-card"]{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:12px;padding:20px 20px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
[data-tll-edit="desig-card"] h3{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif !important;font-weight:800 !important;font-size:18px !important;line-height:1.2 !important;margin:0;color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-edit="desig-card"] p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:#3a3a3a;margin:0;flex:1}
[data-tll-edit="desig-what"]{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:#067A79;text-decoration:none}
[data-tll-edit="desig-apply"]{display:inline-block;align-self:flex-start;background:#D98A2B;color:#0A0B14;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 14px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;margin-top:4px}
[data-tll-edit="desig-note"]{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#6B6660;line-height:1.7;margin:14px 0 0}
@media(max-width:760px){[data-tll-edit="desig-grid"]{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>
<style id="tll-edit-dir-v1">
[data-tll-edit="dir"]{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:12px;padding:22px 24px;margin:0 0 26px}
[data-tll-edit="dir-eb"]{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace !important;font-size:11px !important;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600 !important;line-height:1.4 !important;margin:0 0 8px;color:#067A79}
[data-tll-edit="dir-lede"]{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:#3a3a3a;margin:0 0 18px}
[data-tll-edit="dir-src"]{display:none}
.tlled-toggle label{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr;gap:6px 12px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid #E0DACE;position:relative}
.tlled-toggle label b{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;color:#0A0B14}
.tlled-toggle label small{grid-column:3;font-size:13px;color:#6B6660}
.tlled-toggle input,.tlled-sw-wrap input,.tlled-radio input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}
.tlled-sw{width:38px;height:22px;border-radius:999px;background:#E0DACE;position:relative;flex:none;transition:background .15s}
.tlled-sw:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:transform .15s}
input:checked+.tlled-sw{background:#0A0B14}
input:checked+.tlled-sw:after{transform:translateX(16px)}
input:focus-visible+.tlled-sw{outline:3px solid #D63859;outline-offset:2px}
.tlled-panel{padding:6px 0 18px}
.tlled-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:12px}
.tlled-grid label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6660;font-weight:600}
.tlled-grid input,.tlled-grid select,.tlled-link input{font:400 14px/1.3 'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:#0A0B14;border:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;background:#FDF9F3}
.tlled-lbl{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B6660;font-weight:600;margin:14px 0 8px}
.tlled-lbl--top{border-top:1px solid #E0DACE;padding-top:16px;margin-top:6px}
.tlled-prov{color:#b8791f}
.tlled-tg{margin:0 0 10px}.tlled-tgl{font-size:11px;color:#0A0B14;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 6px}
.tlled-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.tlled-chip{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid #c9b89a;background:transparent;color:#0A0B14;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.tlled-chip[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8;border-color:#0A0B14}
.tlled-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.tlled-link{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 130px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.tlled-sw-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#6B6660;position:relative}
.tlled-lt{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#0A0B14}
.tlled-contact{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.tlled-radio{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:#0A0B14;position:relative}
.tlled-radio span:before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #0A0B14;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:-3px;box-sizing:border-box}
.tlled-radio input:checked+span:before{background:#0A0B14;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff}
.tlled-sw-wrap--relay{grid-column:1/-1;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:#0A0B14;font-weight:400}
.tlled-err{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:#C8325B;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4}
.tlled-err[hidden]{display:none}
.tlled-actions{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #E0DACE;padding-top:16px}
.tlled-save{background:#F0507A;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 20px;font:700 12px/1 'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer}
.tlled-status{font-size:13px;color:#6B6660}
.tlled-note{font-size:13px;color:#6B6660;margin:0}
@media(max-width:600px){.tlled-link{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr}.tlled-link input{grid-column:1/-1}}
</style>
